resources.string: Sheildlenz accessibility service identifies the active foreground application package and enables emergency return-to-home actions when inappropriate visual content is detected. No keystrokes or private messages are ever collected.
Sheildlenz Device Administrator privileges allow Strict Device Owner application suspension policy enforcement.
Sheildlenz Shield status and 1-tap Safe Browser launcher
On-device TFLite screen protection monitor checking visual frames strictly locally on device.
Maintains active Guardian safety lockdown countdown across device restarts.
Local zero-battery DNS filter blocking adult and unsafe domains without remote logging.
Downloads and verifies official app updates requested by the user.
